description: Peaceful ecology after slower needs/lifetimes, actual-prey decisions, migration commitment and vertical hunting reach fixes. Native Mac release observation; no people, no save or network writes.
limits: Only seed42 uses the server 0.05-second step. Other runs use coarse 0.25-second steps and are auxiliary observations. Different step frequencies consume different random decisions and are not exact trajectories.
Natural reproduction only, with no population floor or replacement animals. Predators still disappear in a coarse run; blocked or interrupted journeys remain a follow-up.
Elapsed seconds were collected alongside other local work and are not a production-load benchmark. Stationary migrants compare hourly endpoints and do not prove a full hour without motion.
